content_of_post_to_answer: Why do we sometimes create problems in our minds that haven't actually happened?
answer: Our minds often create future problems because uncertainty feels more dangerous than a difficult reality we can see. The brain tries to protect us by rehearsing threats, but it can mistake imagination for preparation. I've explored this pattern more deeply on my Quora profile for anyone who wants to examine it further. The challenge is not having thoughts about what might go wrong; it is learning not to treat every thought as a prediction.
